scope: Independent bounded source/API/math review only; no shader compilation, actual pixels, performance or art acceptance

findings.finding: Private ground include points to canonical old common, which lacks the two new functions. Private shader alone cannot resolve its new calls.
findings.root_response: Root will create flattened render-ground.gdshader by replacing exactly the include line with candidate common bytes and bind both input hashes and derived shader hash. This review has not yet inspected that new derivation.

findings.finding: Current water dry pool0 normal is original base_world_normal; ground candidate adds bevel slope. Matching color/roughness alone leaves a dry-border lighting discontinuity.
findings.required: Use exact shared candidate slope in dry water border, matched baseline/candidate actual near/distant/wet-border views before promotion.

source_facts: Vertex position function and world coordinates unchanged; no collision/source/geometry edits.
Color expressions preserve original paving, avenue, court and ring mixing; extracted avenue_mix is the same previous max expression.
Roughness, metallic and specular assignments are unchanged.

Fragment NORMAL is viewed-space in the existing shader contract; inverse-view/world/view roundtrip mirrors existing water implementation. Godot shader out-parameters/mat4 arguments/fwidth syntax look valid by source inspection only.
Hermite face gradient 6*t*(1-t)/width matches derivative of t*t*(3-2*t); face.yx product implements two-axis corner derivative.
3mm is the conceptual lighting height amplitude, not physical relief. At minimum38mm bevel width the per-axis slope upper bound is0.003*1.5/0.038=0.118421; no singular division because width>=0.038.
Upper-facing gate suppresses relief below world-normalY0.65; footprint fade spans0.025–0.10world metres per pixel. This source argument does not establish temporal anti-aliasing quality.
